gate.unreachable: Can't reach the console, retrying in 3 s. Make sure you're on the device's Wi-Fi.
cells.limit: This list is the modem's live output. Manual selection changes the carrier network (PLMN/RAT); this firmware does not expose a safe PCI/ARFCN cell-lock interface.
cells.noServiceNote: There is no registered serving cell. The records below are modem candidates/neighbours and are not necessarily usable. The modem may retain the last attempted RAT ({rat}); that does not mean mobile data is available.
cells.noDataNote: The radio is registered on {rat}, but the data interface is not connected; candidate records do not mean usable internet.
cells.empty: The modem has not exposed any cells. Start a scan, then refresh.
cells.noAggregation: The modem did not report valid carrier-aggregation data.
cells.confirmAutomatic: Return network selection to automatic? Mobile data may disconnect briefly.
cells.confirmScan: Start a Qualcomm modem incremental scan? Mobile data may fluctuate briefly while scanning.
cells.scanComplete: Scan complete: {n} network cell records found
cells.confirmManual:
Manually select {name} (PLMN {plmn})?
This selects the carrier network, not the row's PCI/ARFCN. Automatic selection is restored if data remains offline after 30 seconds.
cells.manualSet: Manual PLMN {plmn} requested with automatic failure rollback
ts.off: Not configured. Set tailscale_proxy and tailscale_probe in config.json to enable.
proxy.stateTimeout: Proxy did not reach the expected state within 45 seconds; check the logs.
proxy.backendHint: TUN/eBPF changes are validated and switched transactionally; failures attempt to restore the previous configuration.
proxy.appHint: Use Android-user-ID:package, for example 0:com.example.app. Local app policy does not filter hotspot clients.
err.app_package_invalid: App entries must use Android-user-ID:package format.
err.app_policy_invalid: The per-app proxy policy is invalid.
err.backend_invalid: The transparent proxy backend must be TUN or eBPF.
err.mode_unavailable: That outbound mode is not available in the current configuration.
err.settings_action_invalid: The proxy settings action is invalid.
err.subscription_interval_invalid: Subscription update interval must be at least 15 minutes.
err.subscription_proxy_mode_invalid: The subscription update route is invalid.
proxy.emptyHint: Add and activate a subscription to populate proxy groups.
skew.text: Device clock reads {dev}, {diff} off from this device. TLS and subscription updates fail until it is fixed (common after booting without a SIM).
conns.title: Active connections ({n})
th.name: Name
wifi.autoRestore: Start at boot and restore after airplane mode
wifi.noteXiaomi: {auth} · runtime and automatic restore are separate; changing the name or password reconnects clients
turbo.summary: fixed management address · Wi-Fi 6 · hardware offload
turbo.note: Hotspot settings are synchronized to Android; the system remains responsible for DHCP, NAT and hardware offload.
turbo.confirmEnable: Enable AP Turbo? The hotspot may restart briefly.
turbo.confirmDisable: Restore the stock hotspot? The fixed address and enhancement settings will be reverted.
wifi.confirmOff:
Turn off {band}?
Devices on this band drop immediately. If you are using it to reach this console, come back through the other band or USB.
wifi.confirmSave:
Wi-Fi name: {ssid}
Connected devices will drop and must reconnect with the new name and password.
wifi.switched: Band {state}. Only the switch was applied — save again to change name or password.
usb.stateTimeout: USB tethering did not change state within 35 seconds; check the logs
usb.note: Start/stop is persisted across reboots. Android remains the only DHCP/NAT owner, and USB actions never restart the Wi-Fi hotspot.
usb.confirmStop: Stop USB tethering and disable its boot auto-start? Wi-Fi remains online and USB returns to ADB mode.
usb.confirmRestart: Restart USB tethering now? Connected USB clients will briefly disconnect.
confirm.title: Confirm
confirm.restartProxy: The proxy will be down for a few seconds; traffic goes direct meanwhile.
confirm.reboot: The device will reboot. Wi-Fi is unavailable for about a minute.
https.why: Installing as an app (PWA) requires HTTPS. Install and trust the local root CA on this device once, then open the HTTPS address and install.
https.constraint: The CA is constrained to {hosts}; it cannot be used to impersonate other sites.
https.ios.1: In Safari tap “Download CA” and allow the profile
https.ios.2: Settings → General → VPN & Device Management → install Glovebox Local CA
https.ios.3: Settings → General → About → Certificate Trust Settings → enable full trust
https.android.2: Settings → Security → Encryption & credentials → Install a certificate → CA certificate → glovebox-ca.crt
https.android.3: Open the HTTPS address in Chrome and choose “Install app”
https.desktop.1: macOS: open the file in Keychain Access and set it to “Always Trust”
https.desktop.2: Windows: open → Install Certificate → Trusted Root Certification Authorities
https.desktop.3: Open the HTTPS address in Chrome / Edge and click the install icon
pwa.iosHint: In Safari: Share → Add to Home Screen
err.locked: Too many attempts, try again in {seconds} s
err.password_short: Password must be at least {min} characters
err.cellular_unsupported: Cellular controls are not supported on this device
err.selection_mode_invalid: Network selection must be automatic or manual
err.wifi_android_managed: Xiaomi hotspot name and password are managed by Android settings
err.turbo_unavailable: AP Turbo is unavailable on this device
err.usb_tether_unavailable: USB tethering is unavailable on this device
err.usb_action_required: Choose either the current USB state or its boot policy
err.usb_action_invalid: USB action must be start, stop or restart
err.config.conflict: Proxy settings changed concurrently; refresh and try again
err.netproxy_unavailable: The integrated proxy core is unavailable
